data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: ci-llm-review-runner.sh reads size_action from the classifier JSON output; when size_action=upgrade, the runner routes to the deep tier model; verified by a test that injects a classifier response with size_action=upgrade and asserts the runner dispatches a deep-model call.
- DD4: A diff of any size is reviewed without error — there is no hard line-count cap that causes the runner to exit early or skip review; verified by a test with a large diff.

## TDD Requirement (RED phase)
Modify tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh to add:

1. test_runner_size_action_upgrade_routes_to_deep_tier
   Given: mocked review-complexity-classifier.sh returns {"selected_tier":"standard","size_action":"upgrade",...} and mocked llm-api-call.sh that counts invocations
   When: runner processes a non-empty diff
   Then: llm-api-call.sh is invoked 4 times (3 specialist + 1 arch synthesis) — same as native deep-tier dispatch path
   Note: Currently the runner ignores size_action so standard tier dispatches 1 llm-api-call. The test will FAIL (RED) until T4 is implemented.

2. test_runner_size_action_none_does_not_upgrade
   Given: mocked classifier returns {"selected_tier":"standard","size_action":"none",...}
   When: runner processes a non-empty diff
   Then: llm-api-call.sh is invoked exactly 1 time (standard tier path, no upgrade)
   Note: Confirms that size_action=none does not trigger the deep-tier path.

3. test_runner_size_action_upgrade_large_diff_no_early_exit
   Given: mocked classifier returns size_action=upgrade with a 1000-line diff injected via stdin
   When: runner processes the diff
   Then: runner exits 0 (no hard cap causes early exit) and produces review output
   Note: Verifies DD4 — no hard line-count cap.

All three tests MUST FAIL before T4 is implemented (runner currently ignores size_action).
Add RED markers in .test-index for all 3 new test function names.

Pattern Reference (from existing mock llm-api-call helper in test file, lines 89-107):
  _create_mock_llm_api_call() {
      local mock_dir="$1" counter_file="${2:-}" args_capture_file="${3:-}"
      cat > "$mock_dir/llm-api-call.sh" <<MOCKEOF
  ...counter logic...
  MOCKEOF
      chmod +x "$mock_dir/llm-api-call.sh"
  }
  # Use counter_file with wc -l to assert call count

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — existing tests must not break
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -E "^(PASS|FAIL|Summary)"
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_upgrade_routes_to_deep_tier function exists in tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
  Verify: grep -q "test_runner_size_action_upgrade_routes_to_deep_tier" tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_none_does_not_upgrade function exists
  Verify: grep -q "test_runner_size_action_none_does_not_upgrade" tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] test_runner_size_action_upgrade_large_diff_no_early_exit function exists
  Verify: grep -q "test_runner_size_action_upgrade_large_diff_no_early_exit" tests/scripts/test-ci-llm-review-runner.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED markers for all 3 new test functions for plugins/dso/scripts/ci-llm-review-runner.sh
  Verify: grep "ci-llm-review-runner" .test-index | grep -q "test_runner_size_action_upgrade_routes_to_deep_tier"
- [ ] All 3 new tests FAIL before T4 implementation (RED — runner ignores size_action currently)
  Verify: Run the 3 new test functions directly and confirm they exit non-zero for upgrade case

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Write RED tests: ci-llm-review-runner.sh routes to deep tier when size_action=upgrade
